goal: Rebuild the Ars portfolio as an original cinematic interactive experience.
deliverable: Static GitHub Pages website with six case studies, original art, navigation/motion, QA evidence and GitHub source.

protected_constraints.value: Personal portfolio for Ars; evidence-supported copy; no fabricated achievements.
Static GitHub Pages; frontend first; no paid service or backend.
Fallback, keyboard, reduced motion, native scroll and direct project URLs.
Only the website repo may change; preserve history and inspect expected head.
Prepare reviewable result before any newly required production approval.
